notes: breakfast_dine_in, lunch_dine_in, lunch_take_out: fully verified from official March 2026 PDFs. Descriptions are complete and accurate as printed.
bakery, catering: category/item/price/description/image_url fully verified via live browser extraction (Claude in Chrome) of all 69 individual WooCommerce product pages on 2026-08-08.

description: null means the live product page genuinely has no description written (confirmed, not a scraping gap) -- affects: Carrot Cake, Date Square, Lemon Square, Skor Brownie, Peanut Butter Chocolate Chip Cookie, Pecan Pie, Crustless Spinach & Cheddar Quiche, Plain Shortbread, Skor Shortbread, Jalapeno Mac 'N Cheese, Meat Lasagna, Shepherd's Pie, Vegetable Lasagna. Worth flagging to the client as a copywriting gap to fix in the rebuild.

image_url: real product photo where the site has one. Where the live site itself shows WooCommerce's generic gray placeholder, image_url points to that placeholder and needs_photo is true -- these items have never had a real photo uploaded.

pack_size CONFIRMED from product pages: Butter Tarts = 1/2 dozen (corrected -- not full dozen as category page implied), Cupcakes = 1/2 dozen, Gingersnaps = 1/2 dozen (6 pack), Cheese & Herb Scones = 6 (half dozen), Shortbread = 12 pack. Caprese Skewers, Mini Sausage Rolls, Quiche Tartlettes, Stuffed Mushroom Caps = 12 pieces each.
beverages: extracted from breakfast PDF page 2, kept as its own top-level category since it's not meal-specific.
